BOT.presets.bless.label: Bless
BOT.presets.bless.description: Adds 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws while the buff is active.
BOT.presets.bane.label: Bane
BOT.presets.bane.description: The target makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it subtracts 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws while the buff is active.
BOT.presets.guidance.label: Guidance
BOT.presets.guidance.description: Adds 1d4 to the next ability check or skill check.
BOT.presets.resistance.label: Resistance
BOT.presets.resistance.description: Adds 1d4 to the next saving throw.
BOT.presets.bardicInspiration.label: Bardic Inspiration
BOT.presets.bardicInspiration.descriptio: Offers the bard's current Inspiration die for an ability check, skill check, attack roll, or saving throw, then consumes it if used.
BOT.presets.hex.label: Hex
BOT.presets.hex.description: Marks a target. The caster adds 1d6 necrotic damage when they hit that target.
BOT.presets.huntersMark.label: Hunter’s Mark
BOT.presets.huntersMark.description: Marks a target. The caster adds 1d6 damage when they hit that target.
BOT.presets.fireShieldWarm.label: Fire Shield — Warm
BOT.presets.fireShieldWarm.description: The bearer gains protection against cold and deals 2d8 fire damage to a creature that hits them in melee.
BOT.presets.fireShieldChill.label: Fire Shield — Chill
BOT.presets.fireShieldChill.description: The bearer gains protection against fire and deals 2d8 cold damage to a creature that hits them in melee.
BOT.presets.heroism.label: Heroism
BOT.presets.heroism.description: At the start of its turn, the bearer gains temporary HP equal to the caster’s spellcasting modifier and cannot be Frightened.
BOT.presets.armorOfAgathys.label: Armor of Agathys
BOT.presets.armorOfAgathys.description: On activation, the bearer gains 5 temporary HP per spell level. While they have those temporary HP, a creature that hits them in melee takes the same amount of cold damage.
BOT.presets.divineFavor.label: Divine Favor
BOT.presets.divineFavor.description: When the caster hits with a weapon attack, the target takes an extra 1d4 radiant damage.
BOT.presets.wrathfulSmite.label: Wrathful Smite
BOT.presets.wrathfulSmite.description: The next melee weapon attack that hits adds 1d6 psychic damage. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure, it becomes Frightened. Later checks to end the Frightened condition must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.shieldOfFaith.label: Shield of Faith
BOT.presets.shieldOfFaith.description: The target gains +2 AC while the buff is active.
BOT.presets.brandingSmite.label: Branding Smite
BOT.presets.brandingSmite.description: The next weapon attack that hits adds 2d6 radiant damage. Revealing invisibility must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.blindingSmite.label: Blinding Smite
BOT.presets.blindingSmite.description: The next melee weapon attack that hits adds 3d8 radiant damage. The target makes a Constitution saving throw; on a failure, it becomes Blinded and can repeat the save at the end of its turns.
BOT.presets.thunderousSmite.label: Thunderous Smite
BOT.presets.thunderousSmite.description: The next melee weapon attack that hits adds 2d6 thunder damage. On a failed Strength saving throw, the target falls Prone. The push must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.stoneskin.label: Stoneskin
BOT.presets.stoneskin.description: The target gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. The nonmagical damage restriction must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.enlarge.label: Enlarge
BOT.presets.enlarge.description: The target’s weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 damage. It has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The size change must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.haste.label: Haste
BOT.presets.haste.description: The target gains +2 AC, has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and its speeds are doubled. The extra action must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.longstrider.label: Longstrider
BOT.presets.longstrider.description: The target’s walking speed increases by 10 ft / 3 m depending on the world unit.
BOT.presets.darkvision.label: Darkvision
BOT.presets.darkvision.description: Configures Darkvision 60 ft / 18 m. For reliable token vision synchronization, use a compatible module such as Vision 5e.
BOT.presets.passWithoutTrace.label: Pass without Trace
BOT.presets.passWithoutTrace.description: The target gains a +10 bonus to Stealth checks. The aura, tracking restrictions, and narrative stealth effects must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.falseLife.label: False Life
BOT.presets.falseLife.description: On activation, the caster gains 1d4 + 4 temporary HP, plus 5 per slot level above 1st.
BOT.presets.protectionFromEnergy.descrip: The target gains resistance to the chosen damage type while the buff is active.
The target has advantage on Strength checks. Doubled carrying capacity must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.enhanceAbilityCatsGrace.desc: The target has advantage on Dexterity checks. Limited fall protection must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.enhanceAbilityBearsEndurance: The target has advantage on Constitution checks and gains 2d6 temporary HP on activation.
BOT.presets.enhanceAbilityEaglesSplendor: The target has advantage on Charisma checks.
BOT.presets.enhanceAbilityFoxsCunning.de: The target has advantage on Intelligence checks.
BOT.presets.enhanceAbilityOwlsWisdom.des: The target has advantage on Wisdom checks.
BOT.presets.magicWeapon.label: Magic Weapon
BOT.presets.magicWeapon.description: The target’s weapon attacks gain +1 damage. The attack roll bonus is applied if the module supports it; otherwise it must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.crusadersMantle.label: Crusader’s Mantle
BOT.presets.crusadersMantle.description: The bearer’s weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage. The aura must be handled by applying the buff to the affected creatures.
BOT.presets.searingSmite.label: Searing Smite
BOT.presets.searingSmite.description: The next melee weapon attack that hits adds 1d6 fire damage. Ongoing damage on later turns must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.banishingSmite.label: Banishing Smite
BOT.presets.banishingSmite.description: The next weapon attack that hits adds 5d10 force damage. Any banishment must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.elementalWeaponAcid.label: Elemental Weapon — Acid
BOT.presets.elementalWeaponCold.label: Elemental Weapon — Cold
BOT.presets.elementalWeaponFire.label: Elemental Weapon — Fire
BOT.presets.elementalWeaponThunder.label: Elemental Weapon — Thunder
BOT.presets.elementalWeapon.description: The bearer’s weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 damage of the chosen type. Elemental Weapon’s attack bonus is applied only if the module supports it; otherwise it must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.shield.label: Shield
BOT.presets.shield.description: The bearer gains +5 AC. Reaction casting and the exact duration until the start of the next turn must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.protectionFromPoison.label: Protection from Poison
BOT.presets.protectionFromPoison.descrip: Grants resistance to poison damage. Neutralizing an existing poison and advantage on saving throws against poison must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.freedomOfMovement.label: Freedom of Movement
BOT.presets.freedomOfMovement.descriptio: The target gains partial protection against restraints. Movement effects, difficult terrain, swimming, and automatic escape must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.mindBlank.label: Mind Blank
BOT.presets.mindBlank.description: The target receives partial mental protection: psychic immunity and immunity to Charmed if supported. Protection from divination and mind reading must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.blindness.label: Blindness
BOT.presets.blindness.description: The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it becomes Blinded and can repeat the save at the end of its turns.
BOT.presets.deafness.label: Deafness
BOT.presets.deafness.description: The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it becomes Deafened and can repeat the save at the end of its turns.
BOT.presets.holdPerson.label: Hold Person
BOT.presets.holdPerson.description: The humanoid target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it becomes Paralyzed and can repeat the save at the end of its turns.
BOT.presets.holdMonster.label: Hold Monster
BOT.presets.holdMonster.description: The target, unless it is undead, makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it becomes Paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.
BOT.presets.charmPerson.label: Charm Person
BOT.presets.charmPerson.description: The humanoid target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is Charmed. If the target is already fighting the caster or their allies, configure the save with advantage. The spell's exact social interactions must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.animalFriendship.label: Animal Friendship
BOT.presets.animalFriendship.description: The target must be a beast with Intelligence 3 or lower. On a failed Wisdom saving throw, it is Charmed.
BOT.presets.dominateBeast.label: Dominate Beast
BOT.presets.dominateBeast.description: The beast target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is Charmed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Precise control of its actions must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.dominatePerson.label: Dominate Person
BOT.presets.dominatePerson.description: The humanoid target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is Charmed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Precise control of its actions must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.faerieFire.label: Faerie Fire
BOT.presets.faerieFire.description: The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, attacks against it have advantage. Revealing invisibility may need to be handled manually.
BOT.presets.slow.label: Slow
BOT.presets.slow.description: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes -2 to AC, -2 to Dexterity saving throws, and its speeds are halved. Action/reaction limitations and delayed spells must be handled manually.
BOT.presets.bestowCurseStr.label: Bestow Curse — Strength
BOT.presets.bestowCurseStr.description: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it has disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
BOT.presets.bestowCurseDex.label: Bestow Curse — Dexterity
BOT.presets.bestowCurseDex.description: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it has disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws.
BOT.presets.bestowCurseCon.label: Bestow Curse — Constitution
BOT.presets.bestowCurseCon.description: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it has disadvantage on Constitution checks and saving throws.
BOT.presets.bestowCurseInt.label: Bestow Curse — Intelligence
BOT.presets.bestowCurseInt.description: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it has disadvantage on Intelligence checks and saving throws.
BOT.presets.bestowCurseWis.label: Bestow Curse — Wisdom
BOT.presets.bestowCurseWis.description: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it has disadvantage on Wisdom checks and saving throws.
BOT.presets.bestowCurseCha.label: Bestow Curse — Charisma
BOT.presets.bestowCurseCha.description: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it has disadvantage on Charisma checks and saving throws.

BOT.ui.endConditions.onSpellCast: End when bearer casts a spell
BOT.presets.invisibility.label: Invisibility
BOT.presets.invisibility.description: The target becomes Invisible. The buff ends automatically if its bearer attacks or casts a spell.
BOT.presets.greaterInvisibility.label: Greater Invisibility
BOT.presets.greaterInvisibility.descript: The target becomes Invisible without automatic ending on attack or spell cast.
BOT.ui.saveRepeat.onDamaged: Also repeat the save when the bearer takes damage
BOT.presets.blur.label: Blur
BOT.presets.blur.description: Attacks against the bearer have disadvantage while the buff is active.
BOT.presets.protectionFromEvilAndGood.de: The target gains protection against certain creature types: immunity to Charmed/Frightened and disadvantage on attacks from those creatures. Possession must still be handled manually.
BOT.ui.defense.incomingAttackAttackTypes: Without selected types, advantage or disadvantage applies to all attacks against the bearer. Select one or more types to limit it.

BOT.notifications.noStackBlocked: {item} was not applied to {target}: {existing} already occupies this non-stackable effect category.
BOT.ui.multiTargetLimit.title: Target limit
BOT.ui.reminders.title: Automatic reminders
BOT.presets.slow.reminder: The target can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both, and cannot use reactions. Spells with a casting time of one action may be delayed.
BOT.presets.freedomOfMovement.reminder: Manually check effects related to difficult terrain, swimming, and specific restraints.
BOT.presets.protectionFromEvilAndGood.re: Possession and some specific interactions must be handled manually.
BOT.ui.trigger.recurringTurnHelp: This trigger is useful for recurring effects: damage, healing, temporary hit points, or statuses applied on each of the bearer’s turns.
BOT.ui.endConditions.onDamageTakenTypesH: If no damage type is selected, any received damage can end the buff.
BOT.ui.endConditions.onTemporaryHpLost: When the bearer has no temporary HP left
BOT.presets.testFallbackDamagedA.label: [TEST] Fallback - Damaged A
BOT.presets.testFallbackDamagedA.descrip: When the bearer takes damage, deals 1 force damage to the attacker.
BOT.presets.testFallbackDamagedB.label: [TEST] Fallback - Damaged B
BOT.presets.testFallbackDamagedB.descrip: When the bearer takes damage, deals 1 psychic damage to the attacker.
BOT.presets.testFallbackDamagedFrequency: When the bearer takes damage, deals 1 thunder damage to the attacker, at most once per round.
BOT.presets.testFallbackStatusA.label: [TEST] Fallback - Status A
BOT.presets.testFallbackStatusA.descript: Applies Blinded and ends only this buff when its linked status is removed.
BOT.presets.testFallbackStatusB.label: [TEST] Fallback - Status B
BOT.presets.testFallbackStatusB.descript: Applies Deafened and ends only this buff when its linked status is removed.
BOT.presets.testFallbackTurnFrequency.de: Heals 1 HP at the start of the bearer’s turn, at most once per turn.
BOT.presets.testReplacementNormal.label: [TEST] Replacement normal
BOT.presets.testReplacementNormal.descri: Simple non-concentration buff for testing replacement on the same target while preserving other targets.
BOT.presets.testReplacementMultiTarget.d: Simple non-concentration multi-target buff for testing overlapping target sets such as A+B followed by B+C.
BOT.presets.testReplacementAlwaysStack.d: Simple non-concentration multi-target buff that always creates a new coexisting instance.
BOT.presets.testReplacementSameEffect.de: Multi-target +1 AC buff that keeps multiple instances while only the dominant instance applies mechanically.
BOT.presets.testReplacementNoStack.label: [TEST] Replacement noStack
BOT.presets.testReplacementNoStack.descr: Multi-target +1 AC buff that refuses another source using the same non-stackable effect category.
Keeps the buff on the caster and creates a stored-target indicator on the selected target. A target is required.
BOT.presets.testDeleteTokenTargetIndicat: Keeps the buff on the caster and creates a visible target indicator on the selected target. With no target, only the caster receives the buff.
Keeps the buff on the caster and applies a protected linked Deafened status to the selected target. With no target, only the caster receives the buff.
